conversions.note: Chord-height sagitta d scales with placement scale k to the Hausdorff bound k*d on every carrier kind (The CAD carrier record).

Segment count n is invariant under placement, and a circular kind of placed radius r converts it to the Hausdorff bound r*(1-cos(abs(deltaTheta)/(2*n))) once the sweep is in radians, while a Spiral converts through the clothoid Linearizes bound kappa_max*(L/n)^2/8 with h = L/n, computed from the placed kappa_max and L (under similarity scale k, curvature scales 1/k and length scales k) (claimId 0007-clothoid-linearize), and every other kind declines as ID_ToleranceKindUnsupported (The CAD carrier record).

Angle step alpha is invariant under placement, and a circular kind of placed radius r converts it to the Hausdorff bound r*(1-cos(alpha/2)) once alpha is in radians, while a Spiral converts through the clothoid Linearizes bound alpha^2/(8*kappa_max) with h = alpha/kappa_max and n = ceil(L*kappa_max/alpha) at n >= 2 (kappa_max > 0 because k0 != k1), computed from the placed kappa_max and L (under similarity scale k, curvature scales 1/k and length scales k) (claimId 0007-clothoid-linearize), and every other kind declines as ID_ToleranceKindUnsupported (The CAD carrier record).
Source default states no tolerance number, so it has no Hausdorff bound after placement and is not a decline (The CAD carrier record).
